planets.name: TOI-905 b
planets.description: Transiting planet of TOI-905 with a 3.74-day year, found in 2020.

text.card: TOI-905 b was found in 2020 by TESS as it crossed its star.
text.introduction: It is the only planet known around TOI-905. Its orbit and size follow Davis et al. 2020's fit, the archive's default.
